ANVIL v2 · night forge.
Dark premium, own identity: warm coal ground, Ember heat with a soft glow only on live state, serif display with an italic Ember word, rounded rectangles (no pills), plain canvas (no dot grid), square Ember ports, dollars not credits.

Left column: foundations, Bench, Settings. Middle: components + motion storyboards + migration, Assistant. Right: Canvas, Ledger.

Type: Newsreader (display), Geist (UI), Geist Mono (numbers), all Google Fonts. Nothing shared with Solstice (Outfit/Archivo/Space Mono) or Higgsfield.

Motion tokens and the GSAP plugin per move are on the Components sheet.
